title: OpenGEM 7 RC3 (FreeGEM graphical DOS desktop)

components.name: OpenGEM 7 RC3
components.role: graphical DOS desktop (FreeGEM/GEM AES + apps + fonts)

notes: GPL-2.0-or-later graphical DOS desktop (a FreeGEM distribution, descended from DR GEM / ViewMAX; Copyright 2001-2017 Shane Coughlan). Distributed as a DOS application set: install with SETUP.BAT onto a DOS disk, launch with GEM.BAT. It draws in an EGA/VGA GRAPHICS framebuffer and is mouse-driven, so it is NOT verifiable on a text-mode (0xB8000) console scrape -- the packaging harness reads text video, not the graphics plane. Packaged as a fetchable, honestly-licensed graphical desktop; a full run-proof needs a framebuffer + mouse surface (the app's video/mouse widget path), not this repo's text tooling. Fetched, never re-hosted.
